_comment: Reference for every environment variable the hook client reads. These are normally set in the `env` block of .claude/settings.json (see examples/settings.json), not in a file — the hook does not read this JSON. It exists only as documentation. Shared team settings (URL/mode) can also live in a committed .redi.toml at the repo root; env vars override it.
COORD_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8787   (base URL of the coordination server)
COORD_TOKEN: shared-bearer-token    (must match the server's COORD_TOKEN; omit for open dev mode)
COORD_TIMEOUT: 0.5                   (per-request timeout in seconds; fail open past this)
COORD_ENABLED: 1                     (set to 0/false to disable the hook without editing settings.json)
COORD_ID_FILE: ~/.config/agent-coordinator/id   (where the persistent machine id is stored)
COORD_CACHE_DIR: ~/.cache/redi        (session cache location; the fast path reads it instead of shelling out to git)
COORD_TTL_SECONDS: 900               (claim TTL; also sets the refresh debounce to TTL/3)
COORD_SUPPRESS_SECONDS: 600          (B4: how long a repeat conflict warning stays suppressed)
COORD_FORCE: 0                       (B5: set to 1 to proceed past a block and record an override)
COORD_FORCE_REASON: (B5: reason string shown to the overridden agent)
